seededViolationCases.expectation: a missing/unmaterialized coordination view (no streams/ dir, or RunMode::Silent) renders the empty HubViewPayload -- never a panic, never a fabricated placeholder row

a seeded ledger with one lane + one claim renders those exact rows: the rendered view carries the lane LaneId ("arc-16") and the claim's event id (in-memory fixture: "evt2") from the arc-16 materialized state, including an end-to-end round trip through a REAL filesystem ledger seeded via arc-16's own api::init/claim_all

this module imports only enforcer_coordination::{sync::stream::read_all_streams, ledger::active_claims, events::HubEvent} -- no import path to a mutating arc-16 symbol (api::{claim_all,release,closeout,init}) exists anywhere in crates/enforcer-ui/src/hub/mod.rs; re-rendering the same fixture twice is byte-identical, proving no hidden mutation occurred
a claim followed by its release clears the claim row -- the hub reflects LIVE active state (via arc-16's own active_claims projection), not a historical log
worker.update/task.update events fold into presence rows mirroring the vendored materialize.js semantics (state/summary/currentTaskId, active-vs-terminal task-state transitions)
message/handoff events render as mail rows; a subsequent ack event attributes the acking writer by messageId

arc16ApisConsumed: enforcer_coordination::sync::stream::read_all_streams (typed ledger reader; AllStreams { events, duplicate_count, warnings })
enforcer_coordination::events::HubEvent (read-only field access only; never constructed for a write)

keptExtendedReplaced.crates/enforcer-ui/Cargo.toml: EXTENDED (added enforcer-coordination path dependency, the arc-16 typed read surface this module consumes)

deferredFollowUps: Lane/worker/task/mail materialization is folded locally from the raw HubEvent stream because arc-16 has not yet ported a first-class typed projection for those panels (only active_claims exists today, per enforcer-coordination's own crate-level deviation note) -- this module mirrors the vendored materialize.js semantics faithfully and is designed to swap to a future arc-16 typed API without changing HubViewPayload's shape.

Live streaming via the enforcer-events (arc-25) event spine (named in the workpack's 'Where We Want To Be' section) is NOT wired -- this pass renders a point-in-time snapshot on each call; arc-25 event-driven push updates are a follow-on, not required by this workpack's acceptance block (which only requires binding to LIVE materialized state via the arc-16 API, not a push transport).

ts_rs bindings for HubViewPayload/LaneRow/ClaimRow/WorkerRow/TaskRow/MailRow/SyncSummary are NOT wired into crates/enforcer-ui/src/ts_export.rs or tests/ts_drift.rs -- those files are g05's owns: per WORKPACK_INDEX.md; this workpack derives ts_rs::TS on every hub type (ready for that pipeline) but does not edit files outside its own hub/ scope.

The lease/sync panel named in the acceptance block is represented by SyncSummary (event/duplicate/warning counts from read_all_streams) since arc-16 has not yet ported a distinct lease-vs-claim materialization; when it lands, this is the natural extension point.
